prompt: Sticker sheet of flat vector illustrations in a friendly cartoon style: every object has a thick even dark green outline (#0B2A1E), simple flat fills with one soft shade shape, no gradients, no texture, warm saturated colors. Each object is a single, centered, fully visible item, never cropped. Every object is one connected picture: rays, drops, steam and sparkles touch the object they belong to. A person is a simple friendly figure with a round head, short brown hair and two dot eyes, always wearing a plain orange t-shirt and dark navy trousers, never bare skin below the neck. Plain transparent background, no text, no letters, no numbers, no borders, no cell lines. Strict grid of 10 columns by 7 rows, one object per cell, equal spacing, empty space between objects, nothing touching or overlapping.
